data.narrative:
NODA AI, a Series A defense & security company founded by Philong Duong and Dave Corbett, is currently valued at $125M post-money following $29M in total capital raised. The valuation assessment draws from a peer universe of 10 same-sector and same/adjacent-stage comparables, comprising 8 private companies and 2 public entities (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS). Notable private peers include Stark Defence, Singularity, Anduril Industries, Helsing, and Shield AI, with valuations ranging from $300M to $4.0B at comparable stages.

Two triangulation methods apply to NODA AI's valuation. Stage-progression methodology, anchoring to the $125M last post-money and applying a typical 2.0x Series A-to-next-stage multiplier, implies a $250M valuation. Peer-median analysis across the 10-company comparables yields a $1.0B median valuation, with a range spanning $300M to $4.0B. These methods produce a triangulated valuation range of $212M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median of $625M.

The wide range reflects material uncertainty around NODA AI's positioning relative to the peer set. The upper bound is anchored to companies like Stark Defence at $4.0B, while the lower bound reflects the stage-progression method and smaller peers. Resolution of this uncertainty depends critically on revenue traction, customer concentration, and technical differentiation relative to established competitors in the defense AI segment.
